title: Attack monitoring
content: So, Ive seen a handful of folks talking about the Mallworld attacks, and my last three dreams ive been working with the same group of people working on the monitoring system to tell when the next wave of attacks is. Specifically, one of them actually built the system. The rest of us were part of monitoring and response. Thus being said, ive never dreamt with the same people multiple times in a row, this is the first time, and the man who built the system said he loved me. All of this sounds like a self insert fic and im reeling a bit. This is the first time ive remembered my mallworld interaction clearly, because we were having a conversation about the system, he said he loved me i said "why are all of you saying that to me today" because he was the second one, but the attack alert system went off before we could finish the conversation and it was the largest wave we had seen yet. It was my first time seeing an actual map of mallworld, with this attack wave registering under the ground almost. The man was taller(over 6ft), asian, black hair, soft/kind eyes, on the skinnier side, wearing i think it was a black tshirt or polo and jeans. I woke up as i was seeing the alert and the map, almost like i wasnt supposed to.
